title: Fix long-book chapter navigation and pure-reading scroll

commits.message: fix: make long-book chapter navigation usable
fix: restore independent scroll in pure reading workspace
commits.multi_change_reason: same CHG-008: third fix for pure-reading height/scroll chain after nav and shell attempts

commits.message: docs: attach pure-reading scroll fix to CHG-20260722-008
commits.multi_change_reason: CHG-008 registry attachment for reading-scroll fix

user_summary: 纯正文阅读下左侧章节与中间正文被视口底部裁切、无法独立纵向滚动；此前长书导航补丁未修好该基础滚动。
technical_summary: Attempt1 (CHG-008 f3afc0e): chapter windows/drawer/prev-next + overflow-y on .workspace-chapter-list but missed pure-reading parent height. Attempt2 (CHG-010 24c68b2): app-shell/book-shell height chain, but .book-shell-workspace min-height:0 only under data-has-progress=true — pure reading never hit. Fix3: always constrain .book-shell-workspace; grid minmax(0,1fr) row; chapter section flex column; reading-content-scroll-region as dedicated overflow-y auto; stable testids; Playwright geometry proof.
acceptance_criteria: Left chapter list independently scrolls with 100-chapter windows
Top 章节目录 always opens navigator drawer with search/ordinal/ranges
Prev/next and unified navigateToChapterReading without analysisRun/tab/journeyView
Pure view=reading: chapter list and reading pane each have bounded clientHeight with scrollHeight>clientHeight and independent scrollTop
body does not own reading scroll; scrollbars not hidden
verification_evidence: Manual 1.0.4: book with 1299 chapters, /books/3?chapter=5&view=reading showed only first dozen chapters; no usable catalog search/jump; no prev/next.
Root (nav): openCatalogOrFocusNav focused left list on wide screens; workspace-chapter-list had no independent scroll; full DOM render of all chapters.
Local vitest: chapterNavigation + ChapterNavigatorDrawer + BookWorkspacePage + BookRoutePage (43 passed); typecheck/lint/version/registry/diff-check green.

Why attempts 1-2 failed: (1) CHG-008 mainly added drawer/search/windows and child overflow-y without constraining pure-reading .book-shell-workspace; (2) CHG-010 height fixes applied .book-shell-workspace only when data-has-progress=true — pure reading has no progress panel so wrapper stayed content-sized and ancestors overflow:hidden clipped both panes (case scrollHeight<=clientHeight on list).
Before (no .book-shell-workspace constraint): chapter-list clientHeight=scrollHeight=7014; overflow-y auto inert; clipped by book-shell-main/body.

After Playwright 1440x900 /books/3?chapter=4&view=reading: chapter clientHeight=527 scrollHeight=3076; reading clientHeight=736 scrollHeight=7312; independent scrollTops 480 vs 400; bodyScroll=0; screenshots in audits/chg-20260722-008-reading-scroll/.
Clipping ancestor: overflow:hidden on book-shell-body/main while unconstrained .book-shell-workspace grew; missing min-height:0/flex on that wrapper and grid row minmax(0,1fr).
Playwright e2e reading_workspace_scroll.spec.ts 3 passed (1440 independent scroll, 1024+drawer, 150%/200% zoom).

1.0.5 Phase A engineering gates (not per-item user manual acceptance): pytest 760 passed/50 skipped; vitest 877 passed; typecheck; lint; frontend build; check_project; template governance; playwright smoke+scroll+chapter; focused theme/lens/comparison vitest.
